about: One row per model in the player's statue_<psid> bundles; modelIdHash = String.GetHashCode(model name) (Java-style 31*h+c). The tactical battle reads only damageReactionTableType (0 = dtbattle_reaction_table_normal), modelAttributeType (Stand turns shadows off) and dtBattleHeight (Small for models under 1 m). Other fields are action-battle only.

sources.note: how the client reads the table
model names from the player's statue bundles; heights measured from the model bounds (F-statue-positions)
action-battle-only sizes/speeds and the 1 m Small threshold are ours
